bibliographic.title: The Reluctant Prophet
bibliographic.author: fleischgemuese
bibliographic.description:
Aldric of Thornwick was a farmer. Then the sky turned the colour of a bruise, and the sigils wrote themselves into his hands — impossibly intricate, impossibly clean, the colour of old blood and winter dusk. Now the Iron Covenant calls him heretic, the rebellion calls him hope, and the voice beneath the world calls him vessel.

The Reluctant Prophet is a dark fantasy interactive novel built in Twine/SugarCube, where every choice reshapes Aldric's fate — and the fate of everyone he loves. Navigate a world of fading gods, fanatical priests, and forgotten powers. Lead armies or burn alone. Keep your faith or break the chains that bind it.

Features:

- Branching narrative with 200+ passages across 5 acts

- 6 distinct endings — from divine reckoning to crimson crown

- 3 core stats (Compassion, Faith, Defiance) that unlock unique choices

- Quest & inventory tracking woven into the UI

- Dark parchment aesthetic with responsive design for desktop and mobile

- ~2+ hours of reading per playthrough, high replayability

Some prophecies are written in fire. This one was written in a wheat field.
